title: APIv2 PCR Prep 3/4: EXO
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Prepare deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as follows: place a 96‑well Labcon plate on slot 1 of the PCR cooler (already filled with sample from the previous step); put a pre‑chilled PCR cooler with a Labcon 0.2 mL PCR strip in column 1 on slot 2 and fill the strip with master mix; load 10/20 µL Opentrons tipracks into slots 4‑11. Ensure the P20 multi‑channel pipette is available.

substeps.instruction: Place 96‑well Labcon plate on slot 1 (filled with sample).
Place pre‑chilled PCR cooler with PCR strip in column 1 on slot 2 and add master mix.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, input the required protocol parameters for the PCR prep – EXO (part 3/4) run.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the generated protocol file from the app.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 app.

steps.title: Confirm deck map
steps.instruction: Set up the deck according to the deck map, verifying that the plate, cooler with strip, and tipracks are positioned as described.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate the labware, tiprack, and P20 multi‑channel pipette using the OT App and calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to start the PCR prep – EXO protocol.
